Name: Belt Pirates
Description: The asteroid belts of Star's End house one of the oldest pirate gangs in the Periphery.
ReputationStatements: You've killed some good belter crews outsider. Dangerous, for an inner sphere bootlicker.
You're the dumb muscle, just hit the target. Keep your damn mouth shut and everyone walks away richer.
Ask too many questions and we pay too little. We've got a job we need security on, think you can handle that?
You mercs always think you’re smarter than the room. We've been doing this for centuries, just follow the plan.
Working in the Belt is dangerous for outsiders, we like to keep it that way.
You've got guts and dangerous metal. I think we can make a lot of money together.
Mech-killer, it's always a pleasure. You know, me and the boys have had our eyes on this job for a while...
MissionSuccessStatements: You fought like vacuum-born killers out there. Our scav crews were impressed.
GoodFaithFailureStatements: Cargo didn’t all make it home, but neither did the enemy get everything they wanted. Could've gone way worse.
BadFaithFailureStatements: You left us hanging out there. That's not something the Belt forgets.
